items.q: How fast can you deliver a cold room?
items.a: Same-day delivery is available for most Peninsular Malaysia locations when you book before noon via WhatsApp. Outside that window, next-day is standard.
Yes, every unit is JAKIM-aligned and maintained with HALAL-segregated storage protocols. We can supply HALAL audit documentation on request.

items.q: What temperature ranges do you offer?
items.a: Four tiers: -18°C frozen, -5°C to -10°C freezer, 2°C to 4°C chiller, and 7°C to 10°C cool storage. Need a custom range? WhatsApp us.

items.q: Do you serve all 13 Peninsular states?
items.a: Yes, from Perlis in the north to Johor in the south, including Putrajaya, Penang, and the East Coast. 153 sub-locations covered.
From RM5–RM8 per pallet per day depending on temperature tier. Volume discounts available for monthly rentals. Final quote in 5 minutes via WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I rent for less than a week?
items.a: Yes, daily rental is supported. Most customers rent 3–14 days; some rent monthly with discounts. Minimum 1 day.

items.q: Do you provide cold-truck delivery too?
items.a: Yes, we operate Cold Truck Malaysia. You can book truck + room in one thread for a complete cold chain solution.

items.q: What if there's a power failure?
items.a: All units have temperature alarms and we provide a 24-hour emergency line. Backup units can be dispatched within 4 hours within KL/Selangor.
